description.en: OpenCode's free-tier models on opencode.ai/inference. Requests are sent with exactly the headers OpenCode 1.19.0 sends (the free tier 403s anything else) and OpenCode's environment block (without it the free tier caps daily usage and then 429s), with live model discovery from the inference list, the OpenCode catalog and the console docs.
description.zh: opencode.ai/inference 免费档模型。请求携带与 OpenCode 1.19.0 完全一致的头部（免费档会 403 其他请求）及 OpenCode 的环境块（缺失时免费档会限制每日额度并返回 429），并从推理列表、OpenCode 目录与控制台文档动态发现模型。

description.en: No key is needed. Each account you add gets its own isolated project and session identity automatically.
description.zh: 无需填写密钥。每添加一个账号都会自动分配独立的设备与项目会话身份。
